subject: prd/e2e-verification
statement: Where the feature under test requires human decisions inside the flow it exercises, the harness section shall specify a decision-authority stand-in that supplies those decisions with no live human — a scripted answer set consulted first, a persona fallback constrained to a written character sheet, every fallback answer recorded as an improvisation with the assertions depending on it reported non-authoritative, at least one adversarial persona (silence, contradiction, or refusal), and no visibility of the run's assertions to the stand-in.
rationale: an agentic feature has no other way to reach its own end-to-end behavior; a stand-in that only agrees, or that can see what the test asserts, manufactures a green rather than proving one
fit_criterion: on the agentic fixture committed in §4.2, the harness section specifies all five properties; a stand-in specified as improvising silently, as cooperative-only, or with sight of the assertions is a review finding; specifying the stand-in is authoring, and building or running it remains the deferred follow-on (NG-1, WR-1)
